facts.text: Midway's campus features a working horse farm with 163 acres of pastureland and multiple indoor and outdoor riding arenas for equine studies.

sources.title: Kentucky's Equine University
sources.quote: Equine students also enjoy an outdoor riding arena, a jumping field, and 163 acres of pastureland.

sources.title: Equine Studies Degree | Careers with Horses - Midway University
sources.quote: As a part of our holistic approach to equestrian studies, our campus is a working horse farm providing true access to hands-on learning with our large equine herd of varying breeds and disciplines.
